source_tiers.policy: A row counts as officially verified only when the specific fixture appears on the competition's own site (governing body, league, tour or federation) or on one of the two clubs' own sites. Reputable third parties (ESPN/ESPNcricinfo, Sofascore, AS, TNT Sports, ORF, snooker.org, Eliteprospects, tipsterio, kicker) are kept as corroboration only and labelled 'corroborated', never 'verified'. Where a row had only a third-party source we recorded it, tried to replace it with an official one, and left the tier honest when we could not.
